title: Launch reaches main menu
steps:
1. Open a terminal in the install folder
2. Run java -jar Unciv.jar
3. Wait until a window appears
expected_result: Main menu is visible. No crash dialog. Version string readable.
actual_result: Main menu clean, no crash dialog, version readable bottom-center
notes: Record version into env/ENVIRONMENT.md Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-7.

title: New Game screen opens
steps:
1. Click New game
2. Look for civ / difficulty / map controls
expected_result: New Game screen shows civilization, difficulty, and map options.
actual_result: Game Options / Map Options / Civilizations all present

title: Start a tiny single-player game
steps:
1. Pick any playable civ
2. Set smallest map the UI offers
3. Set fewest AI opponents the UI offers
4. Difficulty Prince or equivalent
5. Start game
expected_result: Game leaves New Game and shows the map. No freeze longer than map-gen spinner.
actual_result: Tiny map, 1 human + 1 AI, Chieftain. Left New Game screen, map shown, no freeze.
notes: If Start stays disabled write which field is empty Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-9.

title: First turn controls exist
steps:
1. Look at the map
2. Click a unit if one is selected by default
3. Find Next Turn
expected_result: At least one unit or settler can be selected. Next Turn is visible and enabled or explains why not.
actual_result: Settler auto-selected with Found-city prompt; Next unit (2 idle) visible/enabled

title: New Game with no mods
steps:
1. From main menu open the mods / content list if present
2. Confirm none enabled
3. Start another tiny game
expected_result: Game starts on the base ruleset. No missing-mod dialog.
actual_result: No mods installed; game started on base Gods & Kings ruleset with no missing-mod dialog (cross-ref TC-003 evidence)

title: Found a city with the settler
steps:
1. Move settler onto a flat land tile if needed
2. Use Found city
3. Accept the name if prompted
expected_result: A city appears on that tile. City screen or city banner is available.
actual_result: City Istanbul founded; banner and stats visible

title: Queue a production item
steps:
1. Open the city
2. Open production
3. Choose a worker or monument or the first listed build
4. Confirm it sits in the queue
expected_result: Selected item is the current production. Turns-remaining or progress is shown.
actual_result: Warrior queued as current construction, production panel highlighted green
notes: Exact building names vary by civ Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-13.

title: Change production before completion
steps:
1. Open production again
2. Pick a different item
3. Close and reopen the city
expected_result: Queue shows the new item. Old item is not still building unless the UI says it was kept.
actual_result: Warrior was current. Monument added, Warrior removed. Reopened city: Monument still current, queue empty.

title: Open tech picker and select a tech
steps:
1. Open research / tech picker
2. Select the first available tech
3. Close picker
4. Reopen
expected_result: Selected tech is highlighted or listed as current research.
actual_result: Pottery selected as current research, shown in top-left tech panel with progress
notes: 4.21.8 listed ANR on this screen — do not rage-scroll Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-15.

title: Research selection survives Next Turn
steps:
1. Next Turn once or twice
2. Open tech picker
expected_result: Same tech still selected unless it completed.
actual_result: Pottery was current at 0/22. After one Next turn it was still Pottery at 4/22.

title: Move a unit one tile
steps:
1. Select a unit
2. Click an adjacent legal tile
3. Watch movement points
expected_result: Unit occupies the new tile. Movement points drop.
actual_result: Warrior moved to Cattle tile, movement 2/2 -> 1/2

title: Unit cannot enter illegal tile
steps:
1. Try to move onto a tile the UI treats as illegal (deep water for a land unit if shown)
2. Observe
expected_result: Move is refused or not offered. Unit stays put. No crash.
actual_result: Selected warrior's six neighbours are land. Visible coast is next to the city, not the warrior. Double-click on that coast left the warrior at 2/2. No crash. No illegal neighbour to refuse.
notes: Skip if no illegal neighbour exists Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-2.

title: Attack an adjacent hostile if present
precondition: Military unit next to barbarian or AI unit
steps:
1. Select own military unit
2. Attack the hostile
3. Read the combat result
expected_result: HP of one side changes or a unit dies. No freeze.
actual_result: Turn 4, 3760 BC. Barbarian Brutes at (1,-7) and (3,6). Ottoman warrior at (-2,5). Greece warrior at (2,-2). None adjacent. No attack. Worked-tiles tutorial kept stealing later Next-turn clicks.
notes: If no hostile in 20 turns mark BLOCKED not FAIL Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-3.

title: Civilopedia opens and closes
steps:
1. Open Civilopedia
2. Open one entry
3. Close back to the game
expected_result: Entry text is visible. Closing returns to the previous screen. UI stays responsive.
actual_result: Opened Civilopedia, opened Contact Me entry, closed back to game screen; UI stayed responsive
notes: 4.21.11 mentioned ANR here Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-18.

title: Resize window mid-game
steps:
1. Drag the window corner
2. Make it smaller then larger
3. Click a unit
expected_result: Map redraws. Buttons remain clickable. No permanent black region.
actual_result: Window reduced to about 960x600, map and buttons redrawn, a tile click still registered. Restored to 1366x713. UI still usable.

title: Change an option and read it back
steps:
1. Open Options
2. Change one display or autosave control
3. Close Options
4. Reopen Options
expected_result: The control still shows the new value.
actual_result: Toggled 'Ask for confirmation when pressing next turn' ON, closed+reopened Options, value still checked
notes: Write the exact label you changed Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-20.

title: Option survives restart
steps:
1. Quit Unciv
2. java -jar Unciv.jar
3. Open the same option
expected_result: Value from TC-016 is still there.
actual_result: Ask for confirmation when pressing next turn still checked after quit and relaunch. Checkbox-center luminance 75.6 on the post-restart shot, matching the checked shot (74.5) and not the unchecked shot (46.3). GameSettings confirmNextTurn=true.

title: Save a named game
steps:
1. Open Save
2. Type a unique name
3. Confirm
4. Open the save list
expected_result: The name appears in the list. No error toast.
actual_result: Saved as QA-20260925; file confirmed at SaveFiles/QA-20260925, copied to evidance/saves/QA-20260925.json
notes: Copy file into evidence/saves/ Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-22.

title: Load the named save
steps:
1. Load QA-pack-2026-09-24
2. Check turn number and city existence
expected_result: Turn and city match the save moment. Map is the same seed/layout.
actual_result: Loaded QA-20260925; turn 0/4000BC, Found-a-city prompt, same units match pre-save state

title: Continue after quit
steps:
1. Quit to OS
2. Launch
3. Continue or Load last
expected_result: Same match resumes. Not a new map.
actual_result: Process fully exited via in-game Exit (confirmed via ps), relaunched, Resume loaded identical turn 0/4000BC state

title: Smallest map still playable
steps:
1. Set every size/opponent control to the minimum the UI allows
2. Start
3. Found a city
expected_result: Game starts. Map has room for the city. No crash during gen.
actual_result: Same match as TC-003: Tiny map, 1 human + 1 AI, Chieftain. City Istanbul founded (TC-006). Map stayed playable through turn 4.

title: Start blocked when a required choice is empty
steps:
1. Clear or leave unset any required field the UI lets you clear
2. Click Start
expected_result: Start does nothing or shows a prompt. No crash. No half-generated map.
actual_result: N/A. New Game fields seen on TC-002/TC-003 all have defaults (civ, difficulty, map size, AI count). No required control could be cleared to empty.
notes: If every field has a default mark N/A Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-4.

title: Save name rejected or trimmed if empty
steps:
1. Clear the name field
2. Confirm
expected_result: Save is refused or a default name is applied. No crash. No zero-byte file as the only slot.
actual_result: Save dialog name cleared. Enter did not create a file. No zero-byte save. Process stayed up. Existing saves unchanged.

title: Owned roads not charged as neutral — regression
precondition: Road on owned tile if reachable in timebox
steps:
1. Have a road on a tile you own
2. Move a unit along it
3. Compare movement cost to a neutral road if one exists
expected_result: Movement cost matches owned-road rules. See BUG-005 (4.22.0 fix).
actual_result: No Road improvement on any tile at turn 4. City center only. No worker. Roads not reached, so movement cost was not compared.
notes: Skip if roads not reached; do not fail the pack Executed 2026-09-25 on 4.22.3. Jira UQ-5.
